candidate.title: How to add Web Search to LLM? Tavily #genai #llm #websearch #google #python
candidate.description:
On February 1, 2025, a major tax announcement was made—but can the LLMs we integrate into our apps accurately answer questions about the latest tax slabs? Unfortunately, they can’t, because they were trained on outdated data.

So how do we ensure our AI provides real-time, accurate information to users? The answer: Web Search API integration!

In this video, I’ll show you how to integrate the Tavily Web Search API into your LLM and build an intelligent agent that retrieves up-to-date information from the web.

🚀 What you’ll learn:
✅ Why LLMs struggle with real-time knowledge
✅ How to integrate the Tavily Web Search client
✅ How to build an LLM agent that fetches fresh information

🔗 Tavily’s Free Tier: Get 1,000 free queries per month—perfect for prototyping agentic apps!

Notebook Link: https://github.com/vyshnavkarunsomasundaram/gen-ai-made-easy/blob/866da76683036596270ed07c4194f85f2d86f650/WebSearchIntegration.ipynb
